response.text: I've been fortunate to win several hackathons and receive recognition for my work! Notable wins include Bunnyshell Hackathon (Team Lead, 2023), Celo's Make Crypto Mobile (1st Place Web3 Track, 2021), Datastax Holiday Hackathon (EMEA Winner, 2021), SaveEarth (2 hackathon wins + AWS funding), and AutoDocs CodeShift (3rd Place). Each win validated months of learning and building!
